sections.title: Quantitative Reasoning for Real-Time Problem-Solving
sections.description: Many government, business and NPO/NGO leaders around the globe are drowning in numerical and statistical data. With this sometimes-excessive amount of data, their struggle may not just be how to analyze the data effectively but also how to utilize it effectively. This course is uniquely designed to enhance your ability to use data effectively for real-time problem identification, definition, decision-making and problem-solving. **For I-MPA students only.**

sections.title: Quantitative Reasoning for Real-Time Problem-Solving
sections.description: This course is uniquely designed to enhance your ability to use data effectively for real-time problem identification, definition, decision-making and problem-solving. In this course, students are introduced to key concepts, principles, protocols, and analytical tools and techniques relevant to quantitative reasoning, statistical analysis, and three separate but related problem-solving leadership skills. A more detailed current course description can be found at: https://www.lps.upenn.edu/degree-programs/impa/curriculum **For I-MPA students only.**
